items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I say, “If you put me in your group, they are not going to let you travel. He say, “That is not my problem. The group is from this way, and these are the people that I want in my group.

ctx.x: And how did you come to be a member of Irakere?

It’s very interesting, still today, I haven’t really explain for. I received a call from Chucho Valdés, who used to play in the orchestra with me, in that dying orchestra. Chucho called me, and said, “Meet me at this park in an hour. Can you do that?” “Yea, ok.” Then Chucho say, “We are forming a group because we don’t understand that musicians that are not as good musicians as we are, are traveling all over the world, and we are still in-landed here. How come you, how come we are not international? We have to do…
And so, what was the instrumentation originally?
